case_id.description: Unique identifier for the case study

practitioner.description: The astrologer analyzing the case (e.g., K.N. Rao, B.V. Raman)

query_or_event.description: What event or question was being analyzed?

factors_examined.description: Which houses, planets, or arudhas were looked at?

vargas_used.description: Which divisional charts were used (e.g., D9, D10)?

dasha_used.description: Which dasha system was applied to time the event?

rules_applied.description: Specific astrological rules cited in the analysis

contradictions_noted.description: Any conflicting indicators the astrologer had to resolve
